description: Create a new merge request. `description` is required (GitFlic rejects empty MR descriptions). If `from` is omitted, uses current git branch; if `to` is omitted, uses project default branch.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

removeBranch.description: Remove source branch on merge (default true)

name: gitflic_mr_create
